findings.summary: RFC3986 path-segment escaping is duplicated instead of using the established route encoder policy.
findings.consequence: Future fixes to path-segment escaping, such as lone-surrogate normalization or dot-segment policy, can drift between Reader facsimile asset URLs and canonical/internal navigation URLs.
findings.evidence: The owned helper at line 18 implements encodeURIComponent plus extra RFC3986 escaping locally. The same escaping policy exists in app/lib/internal-navigation.ts and shared/utils/route-segment.ts, while architecture-policy coverage currently only guards selected route consumers and does not include shared/utils/facsimile-source.ts.
findings.recommendation: Move the shared percent-escape step into one app/server-safe utility, or import an existing shared route-segment encoder here once its validation assumptions match facsimile work-id and image-number segments.
verification: Inspected shared/utils/facsimile-source.ts lines 18-23 with physical line numbers.
Compared the helper against app/lib/internal-navigation.ts encodeRfc3986Segment and shared/utils/route-segment.ts encodeValidatedRouteSegment.
Inspected test/unit/architecture-policy.spec.ts route encoder consumer coverage and confirmed facsimile-source is outside that guard.

findings.summary: Facsimile-size narrowing is duplicated across Reader source utilities.
findings.consequence: If the generated FacsimileSize range or the accepted Reader size policy changes, the two local predicates can diverge and make server metadata validation disagree with shared facsimile URL construction.
findings.evidence: The owned predicate at line 10 checks integer values from 1 through 5. server/utils/reader-source.ts defines the same isFacsimileSize predicate for ReaderFacsimileSize narrowing, and server/utils/work-manifest-validation.ts separately maintains the same allowed-size set.
findings.recommendation: Keep one shared facsimile-size predicate or derive the runtime check from a shared allowed-size set, then use it from both Reader metadata and facsimile URL construction.
